integrity: The structural inequality follows from the published per-factor occurrence cap and the exact incidence balance of de Bruijn walks. The numerical relaxation optimum is certified by integer dual potentials for every possible endpoint pair and a matching feasible deletion vector; no floating-point optimizer is needed for replay.
scientific_limitations: The result is an upper bound, not an exact determination of C(2,7). The capacitated de Bruijn flow is a relaxation and does not encode all positional overlap constraints.
title: A de Bruijn-flow upper bound for disjoint length-seven repeats
